router_inputs.route_objective: Recommend existing provider candidates for a founder explainer Reel without changing active adapter behavior.
constraints: Use only providers already represented by adapter code.
Preserve the existing director, storyboard, visual prompt, voice, music, render, approval, and publish contracts.
Keep all recommendations planning-only until a later implementation session explicitly changes adapter selection.

provider_boundaries.purpose: Structured prompt contracts for story package, director, storyboard, caption, and planning stages.

current_selector.current_behavior_notes: Only the OpenAI structured text adapter is implemented; other text providers fail through providerNotImplemented.

candidates.fit_rationale: Best fit for high-structure story package and director contracts where schema reliability matters.
constraints: Do not switch providers inside workflow JSON
Use only through existing text adapter

cost_assumption.notes: Cost calculator contains OpenAI text model pricing rows for gpt-4.1-class models.

speed_assumption.notes: Expected to be slower than mini models but acceptable for planning and high-value package generation.

quality_assumption.notes: Useful for complex structured prompt contracts with many constraints.

candidates.availability_notes: Available only when OpenAI credentials are configured in local env or runtime credentials.

candidates.fit_rationale: Good fallback for lower-cost structured generation where the contract is already well constrained.

speed_assumption.notes: Expected to be faster than the primary text candidate.

quality_assumption.notes: Appropriate for lower-risk structured text stages and fallbacks.

candidates.availability_notes: Same OpenAI credential boundary as the primary text route.

candidates.fit_rationale: Current default for non-reference scene videos in the v3 helper.

tradeoffs: Published assets still need public non-local URLs for Instagram

Public HTTPS output hosting is better aligned with live Instagram Reel publishing.

selected_route_summary.summary: Use existing adapters only. Keep OpenAI for text, current image/video/TTS selectors as configured, GCS for live-hosted output when available, and local FFmpeg for rendering.

fail_closed_conditions: Prompt requests readable text in generated assets
Reference route requested without consent-safe hosted reference image
Voice clone or likeness route lacks consent metadata
Service-account or storage secret is missing
Rendered output is not a public MP4 URL

do_not_change: Do not edit adapter_config.mjs provider selector behavior in this session.
Do not add provider SDKs or dependencies.
Do not replace local FFmpeg rendering.
Do not bypass final QA, selected-render approval, or client/account publish-account matching.
implementation_notes.notes: This route is a planning artifact for future provider decisions. Applying any env recommendation belongs in a separate approved implementation session.
